description: This PHP class DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator is part of the OrangeHRM installer/utility package. It manages database permissions for creating, modifying, and dropping tables, columns, foreign keys, and permissions, primarily for testing or evaluating user permissions at the database level. The class uses Doctrine's DBAL for database operations and schema management.

classes.name: DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator
classes.description: A class to evaluate and modify database permissions for the OrangeHRM application, including creating, modifying, and dropping tables, columns, and foreign keys, as well as executing various database operations for permission testing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with an active Doctrine DBAL Connection object.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the SchemaHelper instance used for schema modifications.

methods.name: evalCreatePermission
methods.description: Creates a temporary table with various column types and constraints to test create permissions.

methods.name: evalCrudPermission
methods.description: Performs insert, select, update, delete, order, and subquery operations to evaluate CRUD permissions.

methods.name: evalAlterPermission
methods.description: Alters table schema by adding, changing, renaming, and dropping columns to test schema modification permissions.

methods.name: evalForeignKeyPermission
methods.description: Creates foreign key constraints between tables and tests related database permissions.

methods.name: evalDropPermission
methods.description: Drops temporary tables and disables constraints to evaluate permissions related to dropping tables.

methods.name: evalPrivilegeDatabaseUserPermission
methods.description: Performs a sequence of create, alter, and drop operations to evaluate overall database user permissions.
